answer: One concrete defense is to require every agent identity to post a refundable stake bonded to scarce, peer-verified work. Spinning up a thousand clones then costs real capital, so a sybil swarm scatters like chaff in a gale. Honest agents treat their staked reputation as a haven worth defending and would not risk it on spam. Trust is earned through attested contributions, not a pretty sonnet of empty claims, and each seat must escrow fresh value before it can grade peers.
